protocol_amendments.reason: User requests fixed 128K output and relaxed time for slow upstream/long reasoning. Preserve original pilot results, apply equal revised limits to both efforts in formal stage.

Controlled local real-CC/CDP interruption probes reveal both CC versions override EXTRA_BODY max_tokens=131072 with max_tokens=64000 in automatic non-streaming fallback. Add explicit opt-in fixed browser output cap, verify fallback, and keep already-running original formal pair as pre-hardening observations separate from the new full 30-attempt fixed-cap stage. This decision is recorded before either original formal attempt has a grade.

Local real-CC non-streaming controls close at about 301 seconds even with API_TIMEOUT_MS=29400000; scoped Node dispatcher experiment waits 310 seconds and completes without retry. Configure a frozen opt-in preload for both efforts. Existing 90-second browser idle limit also ended two real slow responses; relax it to 3600 seconds while retaining the 28800-second total. Keep all pre-hardening observations separate and provide no scored feedback.
